newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Prime Minister Goh to visit Thailand.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Prime Minister Goh to visit Thailand.

text.p: Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong will visit Thailand from Monday through Wednesday, a Singapore government statement issued late on Sunday said.
It said Goh will be accompanied by Foreign Affairs Minister Shanmugam Jayakumar, Trade Minister Lee Yock Suan, and a business delegation more than 60 strong.

During the visit, aimed at strengthening bilateral ties, Goh will meet top Thai officials and senior members of the Thai business community and Singaporeans living and working in Bangkok, and tour Thailand's Eastern Seaboard.
Goh has made two other bilateral visits to Thailand since becoming prime minister in 1990.
